stem: Voltmarkt's margin bridge computes the price, cost, volume and mix effects only for products sold in both quarters. A new 77-inch TV went on sale in Q3 and earned €30,000 of gross margin. Where does the bridge from Q2 to Q3 put this margin?

options.text: In the mix effect, since a new product changes the product mix
In the volume effect, since the new TV adds units in Q3
On a separate line for new and discontinued products
In the price effect, since the TV had no Q2 price to compare
